title: Survey the Crash
text: Mine 8 Basalt with your mining laser (hold MINE).

title: Ferrite Hunter
text: Find Ferrite Ore (rust specks in basalt) and collect 4 Ferrite Chunks.

title: First Fabrication
text: Craft a Fabricator from BAG and place it near the pod.

title: Arc Smelter
text: Collect Cuprite (green ore), craft an Arc Smelter at the Fabricator and place it.

title: Metallurgy
text: Smelt 4 Ferrite Ingots (stand near the smelter, open BAG).

title: Circuitry
text: Craft 2 Circuit Boards from copper and lumen shards.

title: Defend Yourself
text: Craft a Plasma Pistol. Nights on Verdania are not safe.

title: Xenobiology
text: Defeat 3 creatures. Hostile Umbral Stalkers hunt at night.

title: Harness the Sun
text: Build a Solar Panel and a Battery Bank to power your base.

title: Companion
text: Use a Bio Lure on a Mossback to tame it.

title: Green Thumb
text: Place a Hydroponic Tray. It grows food while powered.

title: Ruin Delver
text: Find precursor ruins and break open an Ancient Cache.

title: Assembly Line
text: Craft and place an Assembler for advanced parts.

title: Wheels
text: Craft a Rover Deploy Kit and deploy it (USE).

title: Automation
text: Place a Drone Miner Bay. Its drone mines nearby ore for you.

title: Launch Pad
text: Place a Launch Pad and install a hull, engine and nav computer.

title: First Jump
text: Fly to another world: Kryos, Aridus or the Kessler Belt.

title: Refinery
text: Craft a Refinery to process uranite, cobalt and void shards.

title: Fusion
text: Refine a Fusion Core. It powers the Mk3 tool and Fusion Engine.

title: Into the Fire
text: Upgrade to a Fusion Engine and land on Pyrrhos.

title: The Anomaly
text: Reach Nullara (needs tier 3) and find the anomaly near X 160 Z 160.

title: Terraformer
text: Build and power a Terraformer on any world.

title: Breathe
text: Raise a planet's atmosphere to 100%.

title: Gaia
text: Bring a world to 100% life. Then do it again elsewhere.
